name: freeinference-companion
description: FreeInference Companion plugin for Codex: user-requested provider diagnostics, model discovery, and setup guidance. It is skill-only, never proxies inference traffic, and reports Codex context/cache measurements as unavailable. Community-built and unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FreeInference.

interface.shortDescription: FreeInference diagnostics and setup guidance for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Community-built, skill-only Codex plugin with provider diagnostics, model discovery, and configuration guidance. It installs no lifecycle hooks, never proxies prompts, and adds no inference requests. Codex context and cache metrics remain unavailable because Codex does not expose those live measurements to plugins.
defaultPrompt: Check FreeInference service status and provider configuration.
